resources.string: Pocket Code can read visible app text and click, type or scroll. It can also take an approved screenshot and perform one approved tap at a time using that screenshot. Every screenshot and visual tap requires a separate confirmation, even when automatic navigation is enabled. Approved screen content and images are sent through 9Router to the model. Password nodes and known system/security/financial apps are blocked heuristically, but sensitive content cannot always be detected. Never use on sensitive screens. Disable this service when finished.
